Xendit is the financial technology platform built for businesses that move fast. We give companies one unified platform for payment acceptance, payouts, treasury and financial services, replacing fragmented local integrations with a single infrastructure layer. We serve businesses of every size, from high-growth startups to global enterprises, processing high-volume transactions across Southeast Asia and beyond, with more markets on our global expansion roadmap.

About the Job

As a key technical leader, you will drive customer trust and company growth by bridging Operations, Product, and Engineering to solve our most complex technical escalations. In this role, you will own high-impact incident management, establish robust troubleshooting standards, and turn recurring operational challenges into scalable, automated solutions. Facing the fast-paced challenge of resolving critical merchant issues, your leadership will optimize operational efficiency, elevate team capabilities, and directly shape product improvements to support our long-term scale.

Minimum Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in technical support, product support, software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical domain, with demonstrated experience handling complex technical issues and customer-impacting incidents.
• Proven experience leading people, teams, or complex technical/operational programs, with the ability to coach team members, manage performance, and drive accountability.
• Strong technical understanding of software products and systems, including experience with areas such as APIs, system integrations, databases, scripting/automation, troubleshooting, or software development. Candidates with hands-on experience in technical leadership, or similar technical roles are highly valued.
• Strong experience in structured troubleshooting, root cause analysis, incident investigation, and identifying scalable solutions to prevent recurring technical issues.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear and actionable information for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Strong ownership mindset and ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment, prioritizing customer impact, business needs, and operational risks.

Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking, SaaS, or other technology-driven industries, with a strong understanding of payment flows, transaction life cycles, APIs, integrations, and industry-specific considerations.
• Previous experience as a Product Manager, Technical Lead, Software Engineer Lead, Solutions Engineer Lead, or similar role, providing strong exposure to product development and technology processes.
• Hands-on experience with automation, scripting, API integration, data analysis, or software development, with the ability to identify opportunities to automate repetitive operational processes.
• Experience building or improving technical support functions, L2 support models, incident management processes, escalation frameworks, or technical troubleshooting methodologies.
• Experience designing and maintaining knowledge bases, SOPs, technical documentation, troubleshooting guides, and other scalable knowledge-sharing mechanisms.
• Experience using data and operational insights to identify systemic customer issues and influence product improvements, bug prioritization, or feature development.
• Experience working with external merchants, partners, or enterprise customers in a technical support, customer success, solutions, or consulting capacity.
• Experience driving large-scale operational improvement initiatives that resulted in measurable improvements in customer experience, service quality, resolution time, productivity, or operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Incident Management

• Own Complex Technical Escalations: Serve as the senior escalation point for complex merchant technical issues, leading structured investigation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution across multiple systems or teams.
• Drive Incident Resolution: Coordinate with Engineering, Product, and Operations during high-impact incidents to ensure timely resolution, clear communication, appropriate prioritization, and effective customer impact mitigation.
• Identify Systemic Issues: Analyze recurring technical issues and incident patterns to identify underlying product, system, or process gaps and translate findings into actionable improvement opportunities.
• Strengthen Troubleshooting Standards: Establish and continuously improve technical troubleshooting frameworks, escalation criteria, diagnostic methodologies, and best practices to increase L2 resolution effectiveness.
• Reduce Recurring Issues: Partner with Product and Engineering to drive permanent fixes and preventive actions, reducing repeat incidents, unnecessary escalations, and customer impact.
• Build Technical Capability: Develop the team's technical depth through workshops, technical knowledge-sharing sessions, documentation, and hands-on coaching to progressively increase L2 self-sufficiency.

Strategic Impact & Continuous Improvement

• Drive Operational Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve support processes, workflows, tooling, and team structures to increase efficiency, scalability, and customer experience.
• Turn Data Into Action: Use operational and customer data to identify trends, quantify problems, and prioritize improvement initiatives based on customer and business impact.
• Lead Automation: Identify repetitive or manual processes and partner with relevant teams to develop automation, self-service, or tooling solutions that improve efficiency and reduce operational dependency.
• Build Scalable Solutions: Design and implement scalable processes, tools, and knowledge systems that enable the team to handle increasing complexity and volume without proportional increases in operational effort.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

• Partner with Product & Engineering: Represent merchant technical pain points and provide data-backed insights to influence bug prioritization, product improvements, and feature development.
• Drive Technical Alignment: Translate merchant and operational problems into clear technical requirements, problem statements, and business impact to facilitate effective collaboration with Engineering and Product.
• Enable Customer-Facing Teams: Serve as the technical advisor for AE, AM, CSM, and other customer-facing teams, providing guidance on complex product, integration, and technical issues.
• Strengthen Partner Performance: Work closely with Partnerships and other business teams to analyze partner performance, identify systemic issues, and develop actionable recommendations that improve operational performance and customer experience.
• Close the Feedback Loop: Ensure insights from merchant issues and technical incidents are translated into product, process, and documentation improvements, creating a continuous feedback loop between customers and internal teams.

Automation, Tooling & Scalability

• Identify repetitive, manual, or inefficient support processes and evaluate opportunities for automation, self-service, and tooling improvements.
• Partner with Engineering, Product, and internal technology teams to design and implement scalable solutions that reduce manual intervention and improve support efficiency.
• Encourage a culture of automation and continuous improvement within the team by enabling team members to identify and solve operational inefficiencies through technology.
• Measure the impact of automation and process improvements through metrics such as resolution time, productivity, escalation rate, ticket volume, and customer experience.

About the Role

At GoTo, our business operates at immense scale, speed, and complexity across a technology-driven ecosystem. As the Internal Audit Lead, you will lead the end-to-end execution of risk-based audits, assessing operational processes, internal controls, and technology-enabled risks across the organization. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, you will identify control gaps, evaluate risk exposure, and translate audit findings into practical recommendations that strengthen governance and operational resilience. This role offers broad exposure to complex business environments and requires strong technical audit expertise, stakeholder management, and the ability to deliver high-quality, actionable audit insights.

What You Will Do

• Risk-Based Audit Execution: Plan and execute risk-based audits across payment systems and processes, covering areas such as payment processing, transaction lifecycle, reconciliation, settlement, refunds, chargebacks, and payment operations.
• Process & Control Assessment: Assess end-to-end business processes to identify control gaps, operational inefficiencies, leakage points, and potential fraud risks, and evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of existing controls.
• Technology & Automated Control Audits: Evaluate application controls, automated controls, system integrations, data flows, access controls, and technology-enabled processes supporting payment systems.
• Audit Planning & Fieldwork: Conduct risk assessments, define audit scope and testing procedures, perform fieldwork and control testing, analyze evidence, and ensure audit working papers meet established audit methodology and quality standards.
• Audit Reporting & Recommendations: Develop clear and concise audit findings, identify root causes and potential business impacts, and provide practical recommendations to strengthen payment controls and mitigate identified risks.
• Stakeholder Management & Remediation: Partner with process owners and business stakeholders to validate audit findings, communicate key risks, and monitor management action plans through to timely remediation.
• Audit Quality & Continuous Improvement: Contribute to enhancing audit methodologies, data analytics, control testing approaches, and continuous monitoring techniques for payment-related risks.

What You Will Need

• 6–8 years of professional experience in internal audit, IT audit, operational audit, risk management, internal controls, or related assurance functions, with experience in payment systems or technology-enabled financial services highly preferred.
• Strong experience in payment systems, payment processing, transaction flows, reconciliation, settlement, digital payments, fintech, or other technology-driven financial ecosystems is highly preferred.
• Strong knowledge of IT audit, risk-based audit methodologies, internal control frameworks, application and automated controls, system integrations, and technology risk.
• Familiarity with Bank Indonesia (BI) regulations, regulatory requirements, and supervisory expectations, particularly those relevant to payment systems, technology risk, information security, and internal controls, is highly preferred.
• CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor) certification is mandatory, given the technology-focused audit scope and regulatory exposure.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex payment processes, identify control weaknesses, perform root-cause analysis, and develop practical recommendations.
• Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate audit findings and prepare concise audit reports and documentation.
• Strong stakeholder and project management capabilities, with the ability to work effectively with business, technology, finance, risk, and regulatory stakeholders under tight timelines.

About the Team

Our team, GoTo Internal Audit, is a growing group of dedicated auditors with deepening expertise in our respective areas. As part of GoTo’s Internal Audit function, we support the Board’s oversight role and provide guidance to Management on operational efficiency, risk management, and asset protection across GoTo, Gojek, and GoTo Financial.

Our goal is to be a trusted business partner by delivering high-quality audits that help improve operational excellence through stronger controls and governance practices, while offering valuable insights on the transparency of performance in relation to business objectives. As a publicly listed company, we also play a key role in safeguarding stakeholders’ interests, ensuring asset protection, and maintaining regulatory compliance.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.
